name: Md Omor Faruk
department: Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
bio:
Md Omor Faruk is a Graduate Research Assistant and PhD candidate in Electrical Engineering at the University of Wyoming, USA, where he also earned a Master of Engineering in Electrical Engineering. He holds a Master of Engineering and a Bachelor of Science in Electrical and Electronic Engineering, formerly known as Applied Physics and Electronic Engineering, from the University of Rajshahi, Bangladesh.

His research interests include artificial intelligence, computer vision, reinforcement learning, and wireless communications.

Before joining the University of Wyoming, he served as a Research Assistant in the Wireless Communications Group at the University of Rajshahi under the supervision of Dr. Sheikh Enayet Ullah from January 2017 to July 2023. He also worked as a Business Analyst at Kazi IT Center Ltd., a U.S.-based property preservation company operating in Bangladesh, from July 2017 to May 2019.
